The valuation model considers the fair
value of the un-harvested green leaf as
at 30 September 2023. Green leaf
volumes were determined by assuming
a 7 - day plucking cycle for harvested
leaf using budgeted production as at
30 September 2023 data. This was
then valued using the 2023 similar
competitors’ out-grower average price.

column2:
The valuation model considers the fair
value of the un-harvested coffee
berries as at 30 September 2023.
Coffee berry volumes were
determined based on the budgeted
production for the next six months
from the year end representing the
harvest cycle for coffee. This was then
valued using the projected auction
price per kilogram, adjusted for costs
to sell.

– Expected yields of the

budgeted amounts;
– The exchange rate will be
KShs 154.54 to the US$;
– Climatic conditions will
remain the same.
